request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MARKET

layers.text: Remove the wooden floor deck and its legs under the stall, so the stall posts, crates and barrel stand directly on a transparent background with nothing under them. Repaint all orange and brown wood in pale straw-yellow birch. Keep the red and cream striped awning, the yellow and green goods, outline and art style exactly the same.
